text: All 16 CNBC survey respondents expect the BOJ to hold rates at 1.25% this week. September core inflation stands at 2.1%, with August real wages up 1.5%. Further tightening expectations coexist with bond-market fragility and dispersed yen and yield forecasts.

meta.note: Rate decisions and subsequent tightening remain prospective; survey expectations are not enacted policy.

text: China's industrial profits rose 14.4% year over year in September. Electronics, semiconductor equipment, optical fiber, and raw materials report elevated earnings growth. Retail sales increased 1.1%, while domestic investment and industrial utilization remain subdued.

meta.note: Contraction implies to subdued domestic activity, not aggregate industrial profits, which remain in growth.

text: HSBC reports $18.6 billion in quarterly revenue against $18.93 billion expected, with pretax profit of $9.63 billion. Year-to-date return on tangible equity reaches 18.8%. The bank announces up to $1 billion in additional share buybacks as London-listed shares decline 6.5%.

meta.note: Buyback authorization is distinct from completed repurchases; reported expense declines include nonrecurring legal provisions.
